channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Cork City Council to Give Away 5,000 Free Native Trees This Weekend
item.description: Cork City Council is giving away 5,000 free native trees at three city locations on 9 and 11 March as part of National Tree Week 2026.

item.title: Collision on N40 Eastbound Slip to Douglas E
item.description: Reports of a collision, eastbound slip, from N40 South Ring Road to Douglas East. Take care on approach.

item.title: Breakdown (Bus) on N20 Buttevant
item.description: Reports of a breakdown (bus) on N20 Main Street, Buttevant. Long delays as a result. Take care on approach.

item.title: Cork on a Fork 2026: Festival Calls on Food Businesses to Get Involved
item.description: Cork on a Fork returns 12–16 August 2026. Restaurants, producers and food businesses have until 30 March to register their interest.

item.title: Collision on N71 Innishannon
item.description: Reports of a collision on the N71 between Halfway and Innishannon. Take care on approach.

item.title: Cork University Hospital Extends Visitor Restrictions Amid Norovirus Outbreak
item.description: Cork University Hospital has restricted visiting to compassionate grounds only due to a Norovirus outbreak. Call 021 492 2000 to contact the relevant ward before visiting.

item.title: Ballydehob Gets Major Upgrade to Tennis Courts, MUGA and Playground
item.description: Cork County Council has completed major upgrades to Ballydehob's tennis courts, MUGA and playground, with new surfaces, basketball hoops and fencing now in place.

item.title: Vehicle Fire on N25 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a vehicle on fire, westbound, on the N25 just after the Cobh Cross (Junction 3) turn off. Take care on approach.

item.title: Vehicle on Fire on N25 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of vehicle on fire, eastbound, on the N25 between Junction 2 Little Island and Junction 3 Cobh (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 6 March at 07:18.
